editorialHtml.en:
ChatGPT is the OpenAI chat surface I bookmark for general Q&A, file uploads, and plugin-era habits that predate some of my Claude workflows. It appears in the tools directory next to Claude and Gemini—pick by task, not loyalty.

On aogl.cn specifically

  • Brainstorm article titles before I lock slugs in data/articles/*.json.
  • Explain unfamiliar npm errors when Cursor’s answer feels too terse.
  • DALL·E / image features for quick thumbnails when I lack a hero still—outputs still go through manual QA before upload/articles/.

API vs chat

This page links to chatgpt.com. If I ship features that call OpenAI APIs, I read platform.openai.com separately and do not duplicate pricing here. Official releases may be summarized in briefs when synced.

Five-step bookmark

  1. Use the official button below.
  2. Pick the model tier shown in my account—not rumor screenshots.
  3. No API keys in chats.
  4. Copy edits into git; ChatGPT does not push to GitHub for me.
  5. Re-check 2026-06-18 pricing on OpenAI pages before citing costs in articles.

Coding IDE: Cursor · Image line: girl1 study.
editorialHtml.zh:
ChatGPT 是我书签里的 OpenAI 对话入口，用于泛问答、上传文件以及早于部分 Claude 习惯的工作流。与 Claude、Gemini 并列于工具目录——按任务选，不按站队。

维护本站时

  • 在锁定 data/articles/*.json slug 前头脑风暴标题。
  • Cursor 回答太短时解释陌生 npm 报错。
  • 缺头图时用图像功能出草稿——进 upload/articles/ 前仍人工质检。

API 与聊天

本页链 chatgpt.com。若调用 API 请读 platform.openai.com，不在此复述价格。官方发布或同步到 快讯。

五步备忘

  1. 从下方官方按钮进入。
  2. 选账户里显示的模型档，不信截图谣言。
  3. 聊天里不贴 API 密钥。
  4. 改动抄进 git，ChatGPT 不会替我 push。
  5. 在文章里写价格前以 OpenAI 页面为准（本页核对 2026-06-18）。

编程：Cursor · 出图线：girl1 研究。
